Floe runs on this device with the model provider you choose. This short guide only points to existing settings; it changes nothing on its own.
Add or choose a provider and model in Settings. No account or subscription is required by Floe.
Voice uses the Android speech services by default. Your current choice is kept; change it only if you want a different engine or voice.
Share files into a New Task draft or save them to Notes. Floe asks you to pick each destination and never reads unrelated storage.
Task questions and scheduled tasks can notify you. If you prefer quiet, leave notifications off; every surface still works in the app.
Revisit this guide from Settings → Setup & Feedback. Nothing was forced or enabled for you.
